blocks.text: The History of Education in Korea
There have been big changes to our education system in a short time in Korea.
For instance, frequent changes have been made to our university entrance exam.
What does this kind of change mean?
This means that more improvements must be made to the education system overall and not only to higher education.
Everyday, the tuition of private institutes increases due to the changes in social classes.
This is becoming a daily problem in Korean society.
Only the rich can provide more opportunities for a better education while the poor lack the options to provide a decent education for their children.
Over the years, educational policies in Korea have changed for the better, but they still have a long way to go before they are truly effective and efficient.
The Problems of Korea’s Educational Policies
There are two main problems in the education system of Korea.
First of all, because the population of Korea is continually on the rise, competition within the educational system also increases.
The second is that there is a wide gap between the educational opportunities given to those who have money and those who do not.
Working together, we need to solve these problems, and provide the chance for all to obtain a good education.
